This '''B1 battle droid''' was stationed on the [[planet]] of [[Kiros]] and participated in the [[Battle of Kiros]] in [[20 BBY]]. Under the command of [[Darts D'Nar]], he guarded a [[thermal annihilator bomb]] on [[Kiros]] along with two other [[B1-series battle droid]]s and a group of [[B2-series super battle droid]]s. However, this droid was destroyed along with his fellow droids by [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano]] on [[All Terrain Reconnaissance Transport|AT-RT]]s.<ref name="Kidnapped" />
